description:
➤ WHY DO WE NEED A PILL COUNTING TRAY

A pill counting tray is a quick and sanitary way to handle and count pills. Pharmacy and home users can use it to verify prescription count accurately, avoid miscounted divide plenty of pills tablet, even capsule, into smaller increments. ➤ WHAT IS THE ADVANTAGE OF OUR PILL COUNTING TRAY

Our classic-style pill counting tray for home or professional pharmacy use. The tray is designed to sit completely flat so that round pills, such as gelcaps, don’t roll around and gather to one side or another. Most trays include a small ridge between the counting area and the counted chamber or chute. With some pill shapes, this can slow the flow. 1. Pour your pills to the tray.

description:
Pill splitting is a common, fairly simple practice. Here's how it works: Since higher doses often are not much more expensive than lower doses of the same medication, have your doctor prescribe double the strength of your medication dose - for example, 40 milligrams (mg) instead of 20 mg - then you cut your pills in half at home, and end up with two doses for the price of one.
The problem is that splitting tablets with a kitchen knife or with some other household tool usually won't divide a pill into equal halves. Instead, using a pill splitter can divide medication more precisely.
Our mini pill splitter has a V-shaped wings that hold pills between 0.5-2 (cm)/0.2-0.79 (in) securely, and because it stays securely in place when open - it makes for an easy one-handed operation. The stainless steel blade is sharp and can cut pills into half or even smaller sizes (e.g. 1/4 and 1/8 of the original size). It's lightweight and portable, perfect to carry it anywhere you go.

Titanium is a lustrous transition metal widely used by the aerospace industry due to its ability to withstand the harsh condition of outer space.

Common Problem
▶▶▶1. The screen is not displayed, or the display is faded, and the ringtone becomes smaller?

Check the battery and replace the battery

▶▶▶2. Why is the screen turned off?

In normal operation, it will enter the power saving mode, press any key to wake up the display. If not, please check and replace the battery

It can be washed or alcohol disinfected, but the timer part cannot be washed. Need to remove the timer before cleaning.

MedQ FAQ's

Does the MedQ Lock?
The MedQ does not lock. It has been specifically designed to be a pill reminder and medication management tool where only visual and audio alarms are needed.

Is the MedQ a daily or monthly pill box reminder?
The MedQ pill reminder can be used as a 1 week AM/PM or 2 week daily reminder.

Is MedQ Pill Reminder mobile
Yes. The unit operates on AA batteries so it does not require a plug in. The compartments are also removable if you want to only take the scheduled dose with you. Note - Without taking the main unit you will not have anyway of being notified of that scheduled dose.

Are there missed pill notifications?
No. The alarm will repeat every 30 minutes until the medication is taken. However, there is not a transmitter in the device to allow notifications to be sent out.

The MedQ does not lock. It has been specifically designed to be a pill reminder and medication management tool where only visual and audio alarms are needed.

The MedQ pill reminder can be used as a 1 week AM/PM or 2 week daily reminder.

The MedQ does not lock. It has been specifically designed to be a pill reminder and medication management tool where only visual and audio alarms are needed.

The MedQ pill reminder can be used as a 1 week AM/PM or 2 week daily reminder.

description:
The Asseccorize Difference

There are many keychain pill holders available today, but most people know what these look like. You may need to carry some medication on you at all times, whether temporarily or long term, so a keychain is a great place - but there's no need to announce it to others. The difference with Asseccorize is that the keychain container LOOKS and WORKS like a flashlight. This way, your friends, family, and even children are much less likely to ask about your keychain and what might be inside. If you lose your keys, this keychain will help your small items get returned to you by decreasing the chance of someone getting inside.

Emphasis on Design

Strategy is at the heart of design at Asseccorize. There are 2 threaded screw-off points on this flashlight but it looks like there are 4. The screw-off point closest to the light unscrews the battery chamber and turns the light on if turned in the other direction. The next screw-off point toward the back is false, which was included to further deter someone that may be examining your keychain. The next screw-off point is for the secret compartment and the final screw-off point is an additional false one.

Quality Comes First

Prices at Asseccorize aim to be as fair as possible without compromising the product quality. There are cheap keychain pill holders available, but they are just that: cheap. This keychain has been consumer tested for over 6 months, collecting feedback and concerns from potential buyers. Many changes have been made and we are proud to announce the first of its kind. The keychain will not break off with regular use and is designed to stay attached to backpacks or keys for extended periods. The flashlight is small, strong, and efficient. Our secret compartment is secure, featuring a rubber gasket for added water resistance. Buy once, buy right, buy Asseccorize - the last one you'll ever need.

description: The MedFolio Wireless Pillbox was designed by a pharmacist who has spent countless hours in "brown bag" medication sessions with patients of all ages. Therefore, the features of the MedFolio Pillbox finally address the needs of patients, caregivers, and their healthcare providers. The unique physical features of the MedFolio Wireless Pillbox were designed to keep medication identification and organization simple. The device can be easily transported to every medical-related appointment or the individual pill storage boxes can be detached from the device for those individuals on the go. The unique built-in pill identification system is a portfolio of every medication stored in the pillbox, thereby giving the patient/caregiver the confidence to engage in medication management discussions with their healthcare providers. In order to help patients in remembering to take the "right dose at the right time", advanced medication reminder systems have been incorporated into the wireless device. The device connects to any personal computer by a USB cable and installed software allows the patient/caregiver to easily establish a connection between the device and their home router. A web application accessible from any computer or mobile device allows the user to customize the device to their specific medication regimens and dosing times (device can be remotely programmed too). The medication information stored in the memory of the device will initiate audio alerts and visual lighting reminders at each dosing event. Additionally, users can receive medication reminders via e-mail and text-message (first month free, then monthly subscription costs $2.99 per month). Caregivers/loved ones can also receive e-mail/text message missed dose notifications after a prespecified period of time. The MedFolio Wireless Pillbox allows families/caregivers to monitor real-time records remotely via secure cloud server to determine whether medications are taken on time, late, or missed altogether.

How To Set Up Pill Box Clock Alarm Reminder
◆Switch the machine--- Press and hold the "S"key to turn on the machine, press the 3 key to turn off the power at the same time.

◆At First Press"S" KEY, Then "H" key, adjust Hour(24) --- Press"M" key,adjust Minutes(60)---- You can set 4 groups clock alarm reminder.

◆Press any key to stop the ringing bell.

Common Problem
▶▶▶1. The screen is not displayed, or the display is faded, and the ringtone becomes smaller?

Check the battery and replace the battery

2. Why is the screen turned off?

In normal operation, it will enter the power saving mode, press any key to wake up the display. If not, please check and replace the battery

3.Does the product have a warranty period?

The product warranty period is 1 year, just contact us to repair and replace at any time.

▶▶▶4. How to replace the battery?

1. First use take off remove the timer, first take off the timer to the left and right 2 small grid, you can remove the timer.
2. When removing the timer, open the bottom battery cover and take out the insulated white bar to power it on. (It takes a little effort to open the battery cover for the first time because the insulated white strip inside the cover is a bit tight.)
As with all medication storage devices, keep out of reach of children.
▶▶▶5. Whether it can be cleaned and disinfected?

It can be washed or alcohol disinfected, but the timer part cannot be washed. Need to remove the timer before cleaning.

▶▶▶6. How long does the battery last?

Under normal circumstances, the usage time is 3-7 months, depending on the frequency of your alarm and the battery power.

The Asseccorize Difference

There are many keychain pill holders available today, but most people know what these look like. Emphasis on Design

For Best results splitting pills please read instructions below:

1. Swivel lid open and jaws apart.

MedQ FAQ's

Does the MedQ Lock?
The MedQ does not lock. It has been specifically designed to be a pill reminder and medication management tool where only visual and audio alarms are needed.

Is the MedQ a daily or monthly pill box reminder?
The MedQ pill reminder can be used as a 1 week AM/PM or 2 week daily reminder.

Is MedQ Pill Reminder mobile
Yes. The unit operates on AA batteries so it does not require a plug in. The compartments are also removable if you want to only take the scheduled dose with you. Note - Without taking the main unit you will not have anyway of being notified of that scheduled dose.

Are there missed pill notifications?
No. The alarm will repeat every 30 minutes until the medication is taken. However, there is not a transmitter in the device to allow notifications to be sent out.

Titanium is a lustrous transition metal widely used by the aerospace industry due to its ability to withstand the harsh condition of outer space.

Lightweight and strong - It has the highest strength-to-density ratio of any metallic element. It weighs almost the same as aluminum but is stronger than steel.

DID THEY TAKE THEIR PILLS YET??

For most older adults and their caregivers, medication is a huge part of life. On average, people over 65 take 14 – 18 prescription medications a year. That’s a lot of pills to manage! For health and safety, it’s critically important to take all medications exactly as the doctor has prescribed. But medication regimens are often complicated.

Common issues that seniors run into include:

  • Forgetting to take medication on time
  • Incorrectly taking too many doses at once
  • Taking another dose too soon after the first one
  • Mixing up medications


Managing meds is a challenge for caregivers too. It may be difficult to remember if you gave mom her morning pill or if dad already took his once-a-week pill on Monday. Using a VitaWorks Automatic Pill Dispenser makes it easy to keep track of meds and see if doses have already been taken.
